targets.query:
from(bucket: "edge-site")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "site_health" and r.service == "miners")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seen_miners" or r._field == "expected_miners")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r.expected_miners == 0.0 then 0.0 else r.seen_miners / r.expected_miners }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

from(bucket: "edge-site")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "site_health" and r.service == "miners")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "timeout_errors" or r._field == "conn_errors" or r._field == "other_errors")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "edge-site")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_staleness" and r._field == "age_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "measurement"])

from(bucket: "edge-site")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "optimizer_plan" and r._field == "hz")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "group"])
